slug: 2024-04-23 The Gambia Social Registry - A Success Story in Systems Building

facts.fact: The World Bank says the Gambia Social Registry (GamSR), initiated in 2021, now covers 203,022 households in 40 of 43 districts, about 70% of the population.

The World Bank says GamSR data underpinned the Nafa Quick COVID-19 response (78,422 households) and the Nafa cash-transfer programme (16,966 households), and is also used by the National Disaster Management Agency, the ROOTS project and the World Food Programme.

A related-project note says 2M Corp developed a strategy for modernising The Gambia's national social registry (GamSR) for the National Social Protection Secretariat with World Bank financing, which presupposes an existing registry but states no programmes or dates.

facts.fact: The National Social Protection Secretariat says the Gambia Social Registry, held in the SRIS platform, has collected household data by census approach in all regions except Kanifing and Banjul.
The World Bank blog says The Gambia is implementing a universal social registry covering the entire population.
